su_units_hint: The first {f} active spaces are free; upgrade anytime.
task_t1: Task 1: Add a property split into 3 rooms and link an owner.
task_t2: Task 2: Create a lease for one room with rent and meter-based electricity, and send it for signature.
task_t2_hint: Counts as done once the tenant signs
task_t3: Task 3: After the tenant signs, record the first rent payment on your new room (last 5 digits of the transfer) and generate this month's owner statement.
task_t3_hint: Tip: on your lease, click “Demo shortcut: simulate tenant linking & signing”, then “Countersign & activate lease”; the open invoice then shows “Record payment”.
task_tb: Bonus: switch to the tenant view inside LINE and file a repair request.
tfa_backup: Save these backup codes. If you lose your phone, each one works once.

tfa_required: Your company requires two-step verification, so it can’t be turned off

tfa_s2: Scan the QR code with the app, or enter the key manually.
tfa_s3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
tk_cost_sub: Enter the cost with a receipt; it's added to the {m} owner statement as an expense.
tk_exp_linked: Added to the {m} owner statement for “{p}” as an expense: {a}
tk_note_ph: e.g. Plumber coming Thu 14:00; drain pipe needs replacing
tk_notes_private: Only your team sees these; tenants and owners don't.
tk_photo_sim: Photos are simulated in the prototype; the real app takes up to 6 from camera or upload.
tk_to_exp: Add to the owner statement as an expense
tm_deact_body: They can’t sign in from now on and every device is signed out. Their data and history stay, and you can reactivate them later.
tm_dup: This email is already a member or invited
tm_invite_note: Invite links work for 7 days; a seat is used only once accepted.
tm_last_admin: The company needs at least one admin
tm_role_accountant: Accountant: ledger, bank reconciliation, reversals, owner statements and month-close.
tm_role_admin: Admin: everything, including team, settings and export.
tm_role_manager: Manager: properties, leases, tenants, recording payments, expenses, repairs and messages.
walk_01: The manager adds a property, links the owner and sets the fee rule (fixed / % / hybrid).
walk_02: The key question: whole unit or by room? It decides whether a lease covers the unit or one room.
walk_03: Property > unit > room tree: three rooms at NT$12,000 each. Excel import is available.
walk_04: Shared meter split: even / by days / by sub-meter. Try a rate of 5: above the Taipower average, a reason is required to save.
walk_05: Lease wizard: Room A, rent, 2-month deposit (cap check), due day, metered electricity, MOI template.
walk_06: Send for signature: a LINE invite link + QR with a one-time invite code.
walk_07: The tenant gets the invite in LINE and adds the Tenant Alerts Official Account.
walk_08: LINE Login consent: what is shared, invite code pre-filled, no password.
walk_09: Linked: shows the address, room and management firm.
walk_10: The tenant reviews key terms, then the lease, ticks agree and taps to sign.
walk_11: The manager countersigns. Every step is in the signature audit trail.
walk_12: First invoice is generated automatically: deposit + November rent, with LINE reminders scheduled.
walk_13: Tenant’s LINE: every alert starts with [firm | property room]; the rich menu has four buttons.
walk_14: What I owe and the firm’s own bank account; footnote: the platform never handles money.
walk_15: After paying, the tenant records it: amount, date, last 5 digits, screenshot.
walk_16: Manager’s payments-to-confirm queue: check the last 5 digits, then Confirm received.
walk_17: The tenant sees the status go from Sent to Confirmed, with a LINE alert.
walk_18: Bank reconciliation: upload the CSV; matches suggested on amount + last 5 + date; approve to reconcile.
walk_19: Owner overview: tenant names are shown; phone hidden by default (the firm decides).
walk_20: Owner statement: rent received, hybrid fee (minimum applies), expenses, net to owner.

pl_used_paid_all: {n} active spaces · all billed once past {f}

sb_units_hint: You have {n} active spaces now; change the number to try other sizes.
sb_trial_box: Free {m}-month trial (until {d}). No charge during the trial; afterwards pick a plan or drop back to Free. No data is deleted.
sb_none: You're on Free: {n} active spaces (Free covers {f}).
sb_bank_ph_note: Placeholder for the demo: not a real account. Do not transfer money.

sb_rem_due: Hi {who}: your plan ends in {n} days ({d}). Pay {a} and report the last 5 digits or a receipt.

sb_rem_overdue: Hi {who}: payment is {n} days overdue (due {d}). Pay within 7 days to keep the plan; after that you drop back to Free limits. No data is deleted.

idv_title: Upload your ID for your management company to check
idv_intro: This step is needed before signing: photos of your ID and a selfie holding it.
idv_notice: To complete the lease check, please upload one photo of the front of your ID (national ID card, resident certificate or passport) and one selfie of yourself holding the ID. The photos are used only by your management company to check your identity; only that company’s managing staff can see them, and the owner cannot. The photos are stored encrypted and are deleted automatically {keep} after the lease ends. Under the Personal Data Protection Act, you may ask your management company at any time to review or correct them.
idv_agree: I understand and agree to the use of my personal data described above
idv_doc_hint_2: Front and back, one photo each.
idv_doc_hint_pp: For foreign nationals: photograph the photo page.
idv_frame_doc: Line up all four corners inside the frame
idv_frame_selfie: Face in the circle, ID next to your chin
idv_tip_corners: Lay the ID flat with all four corners inside the frame
idv_tip_glare: Avoid glare: turn off the flash, tilt the phone slightly or move away from lights
idv_tip_blur: Hold still and wait until the text is sharp
idv_tip_fingers: Keep your fingers off the text and photo
idv_tip_face: Face the camera; no hat or sunglasses
idv_tip_hold: Hold the ID next to your chin, photo side facing the camera
idv_tip_light: Use good light and avoid back-lighting
idv_glare_warn: This photo may have glare. Retake it if any text is hard to read.
idv_num_hint: Enter the number on your ID; afterwards only a masked number is shown.
idv_after_submit: After sending, the photos are view-only.
idv_sent_toast: After the check is complete, watch for a notice from your management company.
idv_ten_pending: Sent and waiting for your management company. When the check is complete, or if a new upload is needed, watch for a notice from your management company.
idv_ten_ok: Your management company has checked your ID.
idv_ten_returned: Your management company asked you to upload your ID again. Reason: {r}
idv_wm_ten: For lease checking by the management company only
idv_gate: You can sign the lease after uploading your ID photo(s) and a selfie holding it.
idv_reason_ph: e.g. glare on the photo, the ID number can’t be read
idv_none_mgr: The tenant hasn’t uploaded ID yet. The lease can’t be signed until they do.
idv_no_access: Only Admins and Managers can view ID photos.
idv_logged: This view is recorded in the audit log
idv_ok_toast: Checked. The tenant will see this the next time they open the app
idv_return_toast: Returned. The tenant will see this the next time they open the app
idv_keep_mgr: Photos never appear in exports or reports and are deleted {keep} after the lease ends.
idv_sign_wait: The tenant hasn’t uploaded their ID and selfie yet; signing opens after they do.
idv_ret_hint: Default 365 days (1 year, decided by Ron on 2026-10-20). Only Admins can change it; the personal data notice follows this value.
